name: patchwork-harness
description: The patchwork-harness harness inside Claude Code: a prompt-injection guard on tool output (Jeff's guard adapter) and L4.5 grounding verification on request.

jeff_url.title: Jeff server URL
jeff_url.description: A local Jeff server with the guard adapter (scripts/jeff/serve.sh). Default http://127.0.0.1:8765

guard.title: Injection guard
guard.description: off, flag (warn Claude in front of a suspicious tool output) or withhold (replace it with a notice). Default flag

guard_threshold.title: Guard threshold
guard_threshold.description: P(attack) at or above which an output is flagged. 0.9 caught 90% of planted injections with 1.3% false alarms

cli.title: patchwork-harness command
cli.description: How to run patchwork-harness for /verify: a command on PATH, or a JSON array of arguments
